title: EchoBench: Benchmarking Sycophancy in Medical Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the propensity of models to uncritically align with incorrect user-provided suggestions. The paper measures the 'sycophancy rate' using adversarial multiple-choice visual question-answering prompts that simulate 9 distinct types of user-originated biases (e.g., Authority Bias, Overconfidence Bias, Online Information Bias, Social Reference Bias) from the perspectives of patients, physicians, and medical students.
